easyPrerequisites:
Nissa, Worldwaker must have at least one loyalty counter.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to indefinitely become a 4/4 Elemental creature with trample.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
